They can help you explore your feelings and work on improving communication in this challenging time. Remember, taking these steps is okay, and it shows great strength to take control of such sensitive matters.

question: I've had enough of my husband. What should I do?
answer: Talk to your husband. Don't hide your feelings. Tell him everything you're thinking. If there's any hope left in your marriage, you will make it out stronger than ever before. If not, at least you tried.
